title: Mini Veil™ Translucent Setting Powder - Talc Free
descriptionHtml:
✓ Good for: Pores✓ Loose Powder Formula✓ Natural Finish✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Long-wearing

What it is:

An ultra-refined mini powder formulated with light-reflecting particles to blur imperfections.


What it does:

This powder blurs the appearance of pores, fine lines, and wrinkles for an airbrushed finish. It features an innovative gold sifter and custom cap which allow for the perfect amount of product to be dispensed. Because the Hourglass Cosmetics Veil™ Translucent Setting Powder is formulated without talc, the translucent formula leaves an invisible finish, making it perfect for all skin tones. It is infused with diamond powder for the most refined light refraction without any flashback and sets makeup for longer wear.


What it is formulated WITHOUT:

- Parabens

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Using the Veil™ Powder Brush, pick up a small amount of powder and tap off excess.
-Apply powder all over the face to set makeup.
Ingredients+
Mica, Alumina, Polymethylsilsesquioxane, Methyl Methacrylate Crosspolymer, Boron Nitride, Hdi/Trimethylol Hexyllactone Crosspolymer, Silica, Diamond Powder, Sorbic Acid, Sodium Dehydroacetate, Bismuth Oxychloride (Ci 77163), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492).

Ingredient lists and claims may change or vary from time to time as part of Hourglass’s commitment to innovation and maintaining global compliance. Please refer to the ingredient list on the product packaging you receive to ensure the ingredients are suitable for your personal use.
